decisions.reason: As an articulated construction dumper closely rooted in our existing machinery, sales, and service knowledge, it remains easy for us to improve and support, so withdrawal risk stays low.

This compact telescopic loader line builds strongly on our established engineering base and the multi-model rollout indicates sufficient learning, commitment, and market fit to continue rather than exit.

The material lift line is close to our existing offer and the reported popularity in rental together with a major order gives us clear feedback we can exploit with our current capabilities, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although the compact underground mining loader is more distant from our core range, the strong early operating result shows commercial promise and our in-house R&D gives us a reasonable basis to keep learning instead of dropping it now.
